text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I was just one step away... 
I couldn't reach it—"
choice_data_list: Nah, you ran really well. You did great!
No, that was a great run. You did great!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... I feel that... I 
was able to show the very best I can do 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However... it may be presumptuous of me to 
say, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The training menu you designed for this 
race, the daily body conditioning, and 
everything else—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To repay all the kindness I've received, I 
really wanted to bring you the best 
possible result...
choice_data_list:
Your ability is undeniable. You'll 
definitely be fine next time!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—I suppose... so. If you say so, Trainer, 
then surely—”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I shall put an end to my regrets here... 
And so that I may surely seize victory, 
let us train anew once more—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Next time—I'll make sure this leads to the 
best possible result.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's desire to win should be the 
same... If you want to break away from the 
pack—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: An even stronger resolve is required...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I will face my own feelings once more and 
work hard so that I can win through—"
